content: Yesu kiam yokamai Yesu akire fure Pairoti te Eroti moipiki tei fure ka kori di teime
Ena iran ari yokamai muruwo arere Yesu akire Pairoti moingui tei fure

ena mapunom boire ka kori di tere “No yokamai kanopunga no arinoma nomanenom bei niki de eromie. Yaromi no yokama arinoma ‘Ne yokama Roma yai ori Sisa kongo takis erekeiyo!’ di erome. Te yaromi ‘Na Yai Gumam awi dongua akire di erongua yai moiro ena na Sisa kokonanom iro ari kiapanom moraiye,’ ama epe dume,” di teingoro
ena Pairoti “Ne Yura ari kiapanom yai moino?” diro Yesu mina wakore di tongoro Yesu ka mokom bairo “Ne ka dingamere epe na moiye,” di tongoro
ena Pairoti fi mun ei teinga ari ori te ari yai opai muruwo “Na yaromi tai ta bei niki dongua ta imari dekeiye,” di erongoro

te ari yokamai ka yoporam boiro diro “Yaromi Yuria ari yai opai ka nuwi si erongua yokamai ka di ipo ka dire kura kamui boimie. Koma yaromi Gariri akai tei mapunom boiro ka di erere te epena u tawa ure ka di erome,” di teingoro
ena Pairoti ka i fingua “Yaromi Gariri yai moimbore?” diro mina wako erongoro
yokamai “Yaromi Eroti man kiapam bengui koro tei nem moimie,” dingoro ena Pairoti firo Eroti kakom tei Yerusarem ama moingua iran Yesu awi Eroti moingui tei dongoro

ena Eroti Yesu kanero mun ori wom fime. Koma Eroti Yesu kam wayom firo ena kakom arari “Yesu kanaiye. Yaromi ari ganom nouro dinga tarom benangua kanaiye,” diro moime. Ena epena Yesu kanero mun ori wom fime.
Ena iran Eroti Yesu ka munmane mina wako tomba Yesu ka mokom bairo di tekeme.
Te fi mun ei teinga ari ori te ka di guwo dungua nuwi si ereinga ari yokama ure teina tei arero moire Yesu ka kori yoporam boire di teingoro
te Eroti te yaromi kiminem ari yokamai Yesu kam fikere te kam ka sire gai nokapu ta iro ure fi tere ena tokoi awi Pairoti moingui tei deime.
Ena koma Eroti te Pairoti surai kiam bei teipika te epena kakomirai surai irai tokoi yokoi ei neipire.
Ena Pairoti fi mun ei teinga ari ori yokamai te ari mokoinga yokamai te ari yai opai ama unom boingoro ure kuku boingoro

ena Pairoti “Ne yokama yaromi akiro na moiki tei ure ‘Yaromi ari yai opai nomanenom bei du dumie,’ dimie. Ena na ne yokama moingi gumanomdi yaromi ka di fi tere ne yokama yaromi ka kori di teinga tarom imari dekeiye.
Te Eroti yaromi tokoi awi nonon moipungi tei dongua ena ka kori di teinga tarom ama imari dekeme. Te yaromi tai ta niki dongua bengua nonon si gorapunga yaromi beikeme.
Ena iran na yaromi kupa siro awi mena dowaro beiye,” di erome.
Te mapunom i epe dumie: Yura ari Yai Gumam eikengua inokore ei finga kakom kakom Pairoti ari kan fainga yai ta ewi mena dero dero bemie.
Ena ari yai opai muruwo u ori wom boire “Yaromi si goro! Ne Banapasi awi nonon moipungi tei deiyo!” di teime.
Te Banapasi yaromi iki birom ori tei gaman gere kura boire ena yai ta si goingoro ena kan si teingoro faime.
Ena Pairoti “Yesu awi mena dowaiye,” di firo ena ari yokamai tokoi ka u boi erongoro
te ari yai opai au diro “Ne yaromi akire eri yoro bakomdi tei si goro! Eri yoro bakomdi tei si goro!” dingoro

ena Pairoti ka tokoi diro “Yaromi tora tai bei niki dongoro si goraiye? Yaromi tai ta bei niki dongua nonon si gorapunga na imari dekeiye. Ena iran na yaromi gam kupa siro awi mena dowaro beiye,” di erongoro
te ari yokama yoporam boiro au ori wom dire “Yaromi eri yoro bakomdi tei si goro!” dime. Ena yokamai au dinga Pairoti ka dungua ako ime sungoro
ena iran Pairoti kam ma dero ari yokamai ka dingi gore di erere “Yesu si gorapune,” dume.

Te Pairoti ari yokamai giranomdi gore diro yai ta iki birom ori tei gaman gere kura boire te yai ta si goingua ena kan si teinga faingua yaromi awi mena dere te Yesu akiro furo kiminem yokamai okonomdi erongoro akire fimie.
Yesu eri yoro bakomdi sime

Ena ari yokamai kon fingi yai ta gumam boime. Yaromi Sairini yai kam Saimon. Yaromi epena toka tai woingui tei ma dere ure iki birom ori ikai naro bengoro ena kiminem yokamai eri yoro ire Saimon yaromi kipamdi kau teingoro ena eri yoro iro Yesu mouwomdi fungoro
te ari yai opai munmane yaromi mouwomdi fure te opai munmane kai mei teingoro
ena Yesu awa tero “Yerusarem opai yokamao, na kainam meikeiyo! Te ne yokama nenen kainom meire te gan kui einga yokamai kainom meiyo!
Te fiyo! Okome kakom ta fuka duwangoro ena ari epe duwaime: ‘Opai gan kui einga faikengua yokamai te opai gan kuikeinga yokamai te opai gan ami gan tekeinga yokamai mun firaime,’ epe duwaime.
Kakom tei ari yokama di towaro benaimie: ‘Kopu ori no yokama no birongoro gorapunga faname. Bo te kopu gawo gere no yokama no birongoro gorapunga ama fanamie,’ epe duwaime.
Te epenai ari yokamai eri goikenguamere epe na moika bei niki de nareinga ena iran okome Yai Gumam ne yokama eri goinguamere epe moinga bei niki ori wom de erowame,” epe di erome.
Ena kiminem ari yokamai yai surai ama endiro wime. Te surai kan faipika yai surai moipire. Ena yokamai Yesu suwaingi “Yai surai ama ei gorapune,” dime.

Ena yokamai fure akai ta fuka dime. Akaiyom i kam Birom Yoporam Kopu. Ena akai tei Yesu te yai surai kan faipika ama eri yoro bakom i wako eime. Yai ta Yesu okom womdi sire te yai ta okom korari sime.
Ena Yesu ka epe dume: “Auwo, ne ari yokamai bianom fai erowangua i kore de ero! Yokamai tai bei nareingai kankeimie,” dungoro te ari yokamai sandu sire Yesu gaiyom ako boi bai di teime.

Te ari yai opai arere kan moingoro Yura ari mokoinga yokamai Yesu kam ka sire “Koma yaromi ari suwo munmane akire di erongua ena Yai Gumam yaromi gunom boi tere awi de norongua yaromi morangua ena iran yaromi nenen gam akire duwamie,” dingoro
te kiminem ari yokamai yaromi kam ka ama sire moingui teina tei ure nuwi gikengua towaro beire
“Ena ne Yura ari kiapanom bei erongua yai kawom moranga iran ne nenen ganum akire duo!” di teime.
Te yokamai ka ta boire Yesu moingui biromdi teme eime. Boingua i epe: “Yaromi Yura ari kiapanom bei erongua yai ori moimie,” epe boime.
Te yai surai kan faipika ei goinga yai ta Yesu kam ka ama sire “Ne Yai Gumam awi dongua akire di norongua yaromi moino? Oro? Ena ne nenen ganum akire dire te no surai ama akire di noro!” di tomba
yai ta ka dunguai firo yaromi kura kam di tero “Ne Yai Gumam kuriyom fikeno? No surai te yaromi ama noi goraro beimba
no yokamai tai niki dongua beipikamere yokamai noi gorainga fanamie. Te yaromi tai ta bei niki dekemie,” dire
ena “Yesuyo, ne okome ari kiapanom bei erowanga kakom i ne na inokore ei naro!” di tongoro
ena Yesu ka mokom bairo “‘Epena ne na gere Pararasi akai tei morapunie,’ na ne kawom di ereye,” epe di tome.
Yesu goime
Ena epena oromene kakom tei ungua aro dekengoro te mangi koro koro muruwo tei kamun si boingoro ena aro u oropo suna tei fungoro aro tokoi dome.
Te kakom tei fi mun ei teinga ikom tei gai ta bai diro u suwo fungoro
te Yesu u yoporam boiro “Auwo, na kuianam ne okonumdi eiye,” diro epe diro mora goingoro
te kiminem kiapanom bei erongua yai ta tai i kanero ena Yai Gumam kam akire diro “Yaromi yai yo wom tongua moimie,” dume.
Te ari yai opai muruwo tai kanaro winga yokamai tai i kanero niki de finga ena deinom mere siro ma dero ikinom fime.
Te Yesu ariyoma muruwo te opai yokamai Gariri tei arere Yesu mouwomdi fure Gariri tei ma dere tawa winga yokamai fakai tei moire ari tai beinga muruwo kanime.
Yesu goingua yonom ire fure kongo minomdi tei eime

Ena yai ta ama moime. Yaromi kam Yosefe. Yaromi Yura ari iki birom ori ta i kam Arimatia dingi nem moimie. Te yaromi yai nokapu moiro te Yai Gumam okom muromdi tei nokapu moimie. Te yaromi Yura ari kaunsel moimba yokamai Yesu ka kori di tere tai bei teinga fi erekeme. Te yaromi Yai Gumam ari kiapanom bei erowangua akaiyom kan moimie.
Ena yaromi fu Pairoti moingui tei furo “Yesu yonom iro naro wiye,” di tongoro Pairoti “O” di tongoro
ena furo Yesu yonom iro gai feke yupuire yono akai ta eme. Yono akai i kongo minom ikai man waure einga akaiyom i ari ta koma goinga eikeime.
Kakom i kopuna ori kenom beinga kakom moinga ena ongo Yura ari iron kakom fuka duwaro beme.
Te opai gan yokama Gariri tei arere Yesu mouwomdi fure dere tawa winga yokamai Yosefe funguai ama furo yono akai kanere te Yosefe yono ire epemere man sungua ama kanere
ena inako dere ikinomdi fure eri nurom kipom sungua tarom te nuwi kipom sungua tarom “Yonom i bui towapune,” dire kenom beime. Ena ka mapunom di guwo dunguamere epe iron kakom i yokamai iron moimie.
